info.name: Notifications
info.description: This application adds an internal notification system to an owncloud.online instance. Notifications are triggered by apps like the Announcement Center or Custom Groups and displayed via a bell indicator in the WebUI as well as via the owncloud.online clients. This is a PHP 8.4 fork maintained by BW-Tech GmbH for owncloud.online.
info.author: Joas Schilling, Thomas Müller, modified by BW-Tech GmbH
